API Reference¶

Canonical Models (drum_ml.models)¶

Canonical Metrological Entity Models.

Enforces strict separation between QuantityKind (physical property) and Unit (measurement reference convention), alongside PhysicalConstant and DimensionVector according to VIM3, ISO 80000, and QUDT 2.1.

class drum_ml.models.entities.QuantityKindEntity(**data)[source]¶

Bases: BaseModel

VIM3 Quantity Kind: An abstract physical property (e.g., Torque, Energy, Absorbed Dose).

Note: Distinct QuantityKinds can share identical DimensionVectors (e.g. Torque vs Energy both [L^2 M T^-2]), making QuantityKind a mandatory discriminator in metrological reasoning.

  • label (str)

Symbolic Core (drum_ml.symbolic)¶

SI 7-Base Dimension Vector Arithmetic and Representation.

Parses QUDT dimension string or symbol (e.g., ‘A0E0L2I0M1H0T-2D0’ or ‘L2 M T-2’) into a DimensionVector.

Return type:

DimensionVector

Parameters:

QuantityKind Consistency & Disambiguation Engine.

Enforces metrological rules distinguishing between distinct Quantity Kinds that share identical DimensionVectors (e.g., Torque vs. Energy, Frequency vs. Activity).

Arbitrary-Precision Decimal Verification and CODATA Uncertainty Parsing.

drum_ml.symbolic.precision.parse_codata_value_uncertainty(val_str)[source]¶

Parses standard CODATA string representation with concise parenthetical uncertainty, e.g. ‘6.67430(15)e-11’ -> (‘6.67430e-11’, ‘0.00015e-11’) or (‘6.67430e-11’, ‘1.5e-15’).

Return type:

Tuple[str, Optional[str]]

Returns:

(clean_value_string, standard_uncertainty_string)

Parameters:

val_str (str)

drum_ml.symbolic.precision.verify_exact_numeric_precision(expected_value_str, test_value_str)[source]¶

Verifies that a test constant value matches an expected exact value with zero decimal drift.

Parameters:

  • expected_value_str (str) – Ground truth exact string (e.g. “299792458” or “6.62607015e-34”).

  • test_value_str (str) – Candidate value string from model output.

Return type:

bool

Returns:

True if exact decimal match, False otherwise.

Pint and SymPy Symbolic Equivalence and Unit Verification Engine.

drum_ml.symbolic.pint_engine.check_unit_conversion_equivalence(expr_left_str, expr_right_str, is_temperature_delta=False, rel_tol=0.0001)[source]¶

Checks whether two unit expressions (e.g. ‘1 N’ and ‘1 kg * m / s**2’, or ‘100 degC’ and ‘373.15 K’) are physically and numerically equivalent.

Parameters:

  • expr_left_str (str) – Left-hand side string or LaTeX snippet.

  • expr_right_str (str) – Right-hand side string or LaTeX snippet.

  • is_temperature_delta (bool) – If True, treats temperature units as differences (no affine offset).

  • rel_tol (float) – Relative numerical tolerance.

Return type:

Tuple[bool, Optional[str]]

Returns:

(is_equivalent, error_message)

LaTeX Tokenizer, Sanitizer & Expression Normalizer for Metrology.

Normalizes metrological LaTeX notation into standard parseable arithmetic strings.

str

Parameters:

latex_str (str)

Examples

‘text{kg}cdottext{m}cdottext{s}^{-2}’ -> ‘kg * m * s**-2’ ‘10^{-34}text{ J}cdottext{s}’ -> ‘10**-34 * J * s’ ‘frac{text{N}}{text{m}^2}’ -> ‘(N) / (m**2)’
